title: A user without Settings Finance still gets the default and the shop's terms
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A}, on the out-of-the-box "Service Manager" role (Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data, no Settings → Finance).
    For example: {User-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-20 User.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, is the default.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-20 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Customer" window opens.
  • Step 2: {Term-A} is preselected with its "Default" tag and the shop's own terms are offered, although this user cannot open the Credit Terms page.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “The organization's credit term list itself (the terms that fill those dropdowns, and which one is the default) loads for every user in the shop, as today,”
  • S5-R2: “On New Customer, Credit Terms is prefilled with the shop's default.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "5 New Customer", "6 Customer on a deactivated term" (the pages the PRD names for this story). The design (read in full on 23 Oct 2026) does not draw this case's screen or state, so no design picture is attached; the expected results above come from the PRD.
